Name: BULLET_CREATE_LIMIT_PARAM_ST
Description: Caps on how many bullets of one group can exist at once. A bullet joins a group through its create limit group ID, which is the row ID here.

Fields.Name: Max Bullet Count in Group
Fields.Description: Most bullets of this group that can exist at once. Likely, as in Elden Ring, the oldest bullet of the group is ended to make room when a new one is created at the cap.
